title: The swing “face down” settles them, and the twos move up
assumes: The ones balance and swing and end facing down, which is the actives' own way of saying they have arrived in the twos' place — and the twos, who are not in the swing at all, move up by sliding along their own line while it happens.
quotes: B1  (4) Ones balance  (12) Ones swing; face down
notes: Written on both passes. This is the one reading that leans on M9g's hold-place slide: a call that carries the progression at its end moves the dancers it leaves out along with their own line, which is exactly “the twos move up”. **Measured** at six couples: `closure 32.0000 · progressed 37.7359 · reach 0.1737 short · collision 0.000`, against the record's `0.0000 · 37.7359 · 0.0000 · 0.000`. The least reach of the four readings by a factor of ten, and `progressed` still does not move — so the twos' slide is cheap, and it is not what this dance's number is made of.
